summary: Adds scripts/smoke_test_ccs.sh that injects synthetic drift into 4 critical vault drift CCs (CC#4, CC#39/CC#5, CC#46, CC#48+CC#54) and verifies check_vault_drift.sh catches each. Strategy: per-test git clone of the repo into /tmp, apply the drift, run the check, assert exit code + DRIFT line. Closes the 'fix a broken CC, then fix what it would have caught' pattern observed in m9-65 (49 stale branches) and m9-66 (54 stale SHAs): any future silent CC failure is now caught by a 35-second smoke test that can run before merging any vault CC change.
title: 67 CC smoke test for drift detection

subject.gap: m9-65 discovered 49 stale branches (CC#46 was missing all milestone prefixes) and m9-66 discovered 54 stale SHAs (CC#4 had a broken awk regex). Both drifted silently for many cycles. No automated mechanism prevents a third instance of the 'fix a broken CC, then fix what it would have caught' pattern.
subject.fix: Added scripts/smoke_test_ccs.sh that periodically injects synthetic drift into CC#4, CC#39 (superset of CC#5), CC#46, and verifies the CC#48+CC#54 meta-checks report PASS on clean state. Any future regression that breaks a critical CC triggers exit 1 with a list of failed CCs. Cost: ~35 seconds. Run before merging any change to vault-drift-sweep.md or check_vault_drift.sh.
